# 4 bed semi-detached house for sale

> Property Partners de Courcy O Dwyer are delighted to bring to the market this substantial family home which is nestled in this mature estate overlooking a large green area. The extended accommodation comprises of entrance porch, entrance hall, living room, sitting room, dining room, kitchen / breakfast room, guest w.c., four bedrooms and garage.

## Fakta
- Typ: semi-detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Energetická náročnost: D2
- Lokalita: Arburn, 35 Ballykeeffe Estate, Dooradoyle
- Cena: 380 000 €
